::: {.obsidian-project-charter}
:::

State the background in one paragraph. Name the problem or the
opportunity, and the value of acting now.

# Objectives

State the objectives in measurable terms. Each objective should name
the outcome and the measure of success.

# Success criteria

List the criteria that prove the project has succeeded. Make each
criterion testable.

# Milestones

List the milestones with their dates. Use a table for clarity.

# Budget and roles

State the budget envelope and the funding source. Name the roles:
sponsor, project manager, and the delivery team.
